'''2007 Maryland State Championship Chris Westergard LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
